title: Frontend Engineering Intern
description: Join our frontend team to help build the next generation of mobile bug reporting tools. You'll work on our React-based dashboard, contribute to our component library, and ship features used by 25,000+ apps worldwide.
responsibilities: Build and maintain reusable React components for our analytics dashboard
Collaborate with designers to implement pixel-perfect UI from Figma
Write unit and integration tests using Jest and React Testing Library
Participate in code reviews and team architecture discussions

title: Embedded Software Intern
description: Work on cutting-edge automotive embedded systems for Valeo's autonomous driving R&D programme. You'll write production-grade C++ code that runs on real automotive ECUs.
responsibilities: Develop and debug embedded C++ modules for ADAS systems
Run hardware-in-the-loop simulations and analyse results
Write technical documentation for code modules
Participate in agile sprint planning and retrospectives

title: Backend Engineering Intern
description: Help us scale our backend infrastructure that processes billions of events monthly. You'll work on our Ruby on Rails monolith and Go microservices.
responsibilities: Design and implement REST and GraphQL APIs
Optimise database queries and caching layers
Write integration tests and contribute to CI/CD pipelines
Investigate and resolve production incidents

title: Machine Learning Research Intern
description: Research intern role focused on computer vision algorithms for autonomous driving. You'll work alongside senior researchers on cutting-edge perception systems.
responsibilities: Implement and benchmark state-of-the-art computer vision models
Curate and label training datasets
Run distributed training experiments on GPU clusters
Co-author research papers for top-tier conferences

title: Mobile App Developer Intern
description: Contribute to our iOS and Android SDKs, used by thousands of mobile apps. You'll write native code that ships to millions of end-users.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain features for our iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) SDKs
Profile and optimise SDK memory and CPU usage
Write extensive unit and UI tests
Support customers debugging integration issues

title: Data Engineering Intern
description: Build the data pipelines that power Valeo's perception research. You'll architect ETL workflows that move petabytes of sensor data through our systems.
responsibilities: Design and maintain Apache Airflow DAGs for sensor-data ingestion
Write Spark jobs for large-scale data transformations
Implement data quality checks and monitoring
Document data schemas and lineage
